benchmark_relevant_contracts.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_list_workspaces
benchmark_relevant_contracts.contract: Read-only list of every workspace the user can access. The `is_selected` field marks which workspace MCP operations currently target. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

benchmark_relevant_contracts.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_balance
benchmark_relevant_contracts.contract: Read-only balance: credits, workspace plan, free generations (free_gens — Genjutsu on generate_video, Viral on execute_preset, and AI Influencer Builder via its Use free gens toggle), and free-trial state (free_trial.unlim_available says whether unlimited generations can be spent). Call it for credits / plan / trial questions or after an out-of-credits error. Report the current balance and entitlement state, and explain any insufficient-credit limitation. Do not provide pricing links, purchase or upgrade directions, or trial-start instructions. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

benchmark_relevant_contracts.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_get_preferences
benchmark_relevant_contracts.contract: Read the user's saved MCP project preference before the first generation in a conversation without a destination. auto_create_project defaults to false: omit folder_id and generate without creating a project. When true, create one project on first generation and reuse its destination for this conversation. An explicit existing project or request to work without a project takes priority. A one-off request to create a project is allowed regardless of this flag and does not change it. Never infer another chat's destination. If reading fails, do not auto-create a project. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

benchmark_relevant_contracts.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_create_project
benchmark_relevant_contracts.contract: Create a private Higgsfield media project for this conversation. Create only on an explicit user request or when get_preferences returns auto_create_project=true and this conversation has no destination. The default is no automatic project. An explicit existing destination or request to work without a project wins. Creating a project does not change the saved preference. Call once, then retain project_id, workspace_id and default_folder_id in this conversation and pass folder_id on subsequent generate_* calls. Reuse the existing project on later turns; never create one per generation or reuse another conversation's project. This does not create a chat, website or 3D scene. No starter/brief subfolder is created. Resolve workspace_id before the first call using list_workspaces (full) or workspace_list (OpenAI); use the selected workspace or ask the user when ambiguous. Repeat an uncertain request only with the original workspace_id, name, surface and idempotency_key, even if the selected workspace changes; backend replay lasts 15 minutes, not the lifetime of the chat. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

benchmark_relevant_contracts.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_create_folder
benchmark_relevant_contracts.contract: Create one subfolder in an existing Higgsfield media project. Use project_id returned by create_project in this conversation or explicitly supplied by the user. Omit parent_folder_id to create directly under the root. Keep using the project's default_folder_id for generation unless the user wants outputs in this subfolder; then pass its folder_id. This does not create a project or a local filesystem folder. Creation is not idempotent: do not automatically retry after a timeout or uncertain result. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

benchmark_relevant_contracts.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_estimate_image_cost
benchmark_relevant_contracts.contract: Estimate image generation credit cost without submitting a job. HTTPS image references are fetched, uploaded, and confirmed in your Higgsfield media library; repeated calls can create new uploads. Requires write access. Takes the same `params` object as generate_image: `params.model` is required; `prompt` may be omitted for a cost-only estimate. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

benchmark_relevant_contracts.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_estimate_video_cost
benchmark_relevant_contracts.contract: Estimate video generation credit cost without submitting a job. HTTPS image references are fetched, uploaded, and confirmed in your Higgsfield media library; repeated calls can create new uploads. Requires write access. Takes the same `params` object as generate_video: `params.model` is required; `prompt` and `duration` may be omitted (model defaults apply). For a Genjutsu recreation, preserve supplied reference images with role image and the confirmed driving/source video with role video in params.medias. Copying actions or camera movement uses hf_mult_motion_control; replacing a subject uses hf_mult_replace_object. A video-only price quote does not establish that all inputs for the requested recreation are ready. For custom follow-ups to a Genjutsu catalog video, resolve get_preset_instructions({preset:"genjutsu"}) before preflight; the current request determines the model, not the catalog recipe. Price-only requests may omit reference images and must respect any no-upload instruction. Preparing a complete request requires the supplied images and one confirmed video; ask about conflicting upload instructions. Read input_check for missing roles and reuse prepared_params with resolved UUIDs. A successful quote never validates generation readiness. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

benchmark_relevant_contracts.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_generate_image
benchmark_relevant_contracts.contract: Generate an image. A successful submission returns job IDs; a choice or rejected request submits no job. For credit preflight use `estimate_image_cost` first; HTTPS image references are imported into your media library. Call this directly as the first tool call of the turn with the default model `gpt_image_2_5` for ordinary generation, photorealistic images, typography, and reference-based editing. Consult `models_recommend`, `models_search`, `models_list`, or `models_get` only when the user asks to pick or compare models, or you need `aspect_ratios`, `parameters`, or `medias[].roles` for reference inputs. Reference media can be uploaded media UUIDs from `media_upload_and_confirm`, completed generation job UUIDs, or authorized HTTPS image URLs such as user-provided file download URLs; the server imports HTTPS images into Higgsfield and confirms them automatically. For character/avatar requests use image generation directly; there is no reusable character-training flow here. All arguments go inside the single `params` object — `params.model` is required, `params.prompt` holds the text description, and model-specific parameters are additional keys of `params`. Server returns `adjustments` for fallbacks; invalid declared-param values return a structured error. This tool already displays its submitted jobs in an auto-updating generation widget, including while pending or in progress. Do not follow it with job_display, show_generations, or show_generation_by_ids merely to show or refresh the same results, before or after completion. To await completion, use jobs_wait with timeout_seconds <= 15; it does not open another widget. Use a separate display only when the user explicitly requests one or the workflow requires a distinct preview or approval. Headless generate_*_batch and execute_preset workflows follow their own display instructions. On a transport timeout the submission outcome may be unknown: do not automatically resubmit. Reuse returned job IDs and retry only after the original outcome is known. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

benchmark_relevant_contracts.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_generate_video
benchmark_relevant_contracts.contract: Generate a video; this submits a job. For credit preflight use `estimate_video_cost`; HTTPS image references are imported into your media library. GENJUTSU TRIGGERS: route `Higgsfield Genjutsu` by intent. Copy, repeat, reproduce, mimic, or transfer motion, movement, actions, gestures, dance, or camera motion from one driving video to reference-image subjects -> `hf_mult_motion_control`. Replace, change, or swap an object, product, garment, or character in one source video from reference images -> `hf_mult_replace_object`. These are direct `generate_video` models; reserve ad-multiplier for explicitly requested independent edited variants. Pass images with role `image` and exactly one source/driving video with role `video`. For an explicitly selected /ad-multiplier workflow, follow its resolved instructions before generating. Ordinary requests to multiply an ad do not select that workflow: offer /ad-multiplier instead of silently starting its multi-stage pipeline. Defaults: `seedance_2_5` for general video, `kling3_0` for multi-shot, audio, or motion transfer, and `minimax_h3` for 2K keyframes or mixed references. Call model discovery only to compare models or inspect parameters/media roles. References may be uploaded media UUIDs, completed job UUIDs, or authorized HTTPS image URLs. For image-to-video use the model's image role, usually `start_image` or `image`, not `video`. Use Marketing Studio product tools for product IDs and list hooks/settings before using their IDs. Put everything in `params`; `params.model` is required and `params.prompt` contains the brief. Apply returned adjustments; invalid values return a structured error. FREE GENJUTSU RUN: balance / models_list report free_gens; when the user asks to use a free generation on a Genjutsu model, pass use_free_gens:true (480p/720p, one output) — it is refused, never billed, when it does not apply. This tool already displays its submitted jobs in an auto-updating generation widget, including while pending or in progress. Do not follow it with job_display, show_generations, or show_generation_by_ids merely to show or refresh the same results, before or after completion. To await completion, use jobs_wait with timeout_seconds <= 15; it does not open another widget. Use a separate display only when the user explicitly requests one or the workflow requires a distinct preview or approval. Headless generate_*_batch and execute_preset workflows follow their own display instructions. On a transport timeout the submission outcome may be unknown: do not automatically resubmit. Reuse returned job IDs and retry only after the original outcome is known. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

benchmark_relevant_contracts.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_jobs_wait
benchmark_relevant_contracts.contract: Long-poll 1-8 generation jobs together without opening a widget. Waits up to timeout_seconds (default 15, max 15) for every job to reach a terminal state, then returns compact indexed statuses and result URLs. Use job IDs returned by generate_image_batch, generate_video_batch, or generate_audio_batch. For larger sets, choose groups of at most 8 and wait for each group. Permanent lookup failures are returned once without blocking the other jobs; transient lookup failures are retried within the timeout. When all_terminal is false, wait poll_after_seconds before calling again. After every wait group in the user's generation set is terminal, collect their indexed jobs and display them with one show_generation_by_ids call when within that tool's limit. Never use show_generations or call job_display once per batch job. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

benchmark_relevant_contracts.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_media_upload_and_confirm
benchmark_relevant_contracts.contract: OpenAI attachment-only upload helper. Use this only for a user-provided ChatGPT attachment passed in the file parameter, one attachment per call. This tool downloads the OpenAI file, creates a Higgsfield upload slot, uploads bytes to storage, confirms the upload, and returns a media_id ready for downstream tools. It cannot read a path created inside sandbox_exec: for a sandbox output, call media_upload before the producing command, PUT the file from that same command, then call media_confirm after HTTP 200. Use type 'file' for general attachments (documents, archives, code); those return a permanent URL but cannot be used as generation inputs. Do not call media_confirm after media_upload_and_confirm. Max file size: 100 MiB. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

benchmark_relevant_contracts.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_media_upload
benchmark_relevant_contracts.contract: Upload media for use in generation, or general files (documents, archives, code) for sharing. Returns presigned URLs for clients that can upload bytes themselves; run the generated curl commands or PUT the bytes to each upload_url, then call media_confirm. The media type is inferred from the filename extension: image/video/audio extensions become generation inputs; other whitelisted extensions (pdf, zip, tar, docx, csv, code files, …) are uploaded as general files and return a permanent URL, but cannot be used as generation inputs. General files are the agent's own upload path — the widget does not accept them, so upload the bytes to upload_url yourself (e.g. from a code execution environment). Supports batch uploads via files[]. OpenAI routing: use this only for files created inside sandbox_exec. Call media_upload BEFORE the sandbox command that creates the file, then append `curl -f -X PUT --upload-file <sandbox-path> '<upload_url>'` to that SAME command so the ephemeral file is uploaded before it exits; call media_confirm only after HTTP 200. For a user-provided ChatGPT attachment call media_upload_and_confirm instead. Never pass a sandbox path to media_upload_and_confirm. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

benchmark_relevant_contracts.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_media_confirm
benchmark_relevant_contracts.contract: Confirm file uploads after using media_upload's upload_url method. Call this only after every curl PUT returned HTTP 200. Supports confirming multiple uploads at once via media_ids. OpenAI routing: use this for sandbox-created files uploaded through media_upload + sandbox_exec. Do not call it after media_upload_and_confirm; ChatGPT attachments handled by that tool are already confirmed. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

benchmark_relevant_contracts.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_sandbox_exec
benchmark_relevant_contracts.contract: Execute a shell command in a remote Higgsfield cloud Linux sandbox — NOT your local machine or the client's own shell. Use it for Higgsfield media workflows and website_repo_access checkouts that require the hosted toolchain. Do not use it to inspect a local repository, install desktop software, or control applications on the user's computer. Preinstalled: ffmpeg/ffprobe, ImageMagick, sox, python3 with Pillow and faster-whisper, node/npm/npx, sharp-cli, Playwright with headless Chromium, caption fonts (Metropolis, Montserrat), zip/unzip, git, curl, jq. Use it for media processing (trim, convert, overlay, concat with ffmpeg), image manipulation, and packaging that dedicated Higgsfield tools do not cover. The sandbox is isolated per user. After its running lease expires it pauses with files and process memory preserved; a later call resumes it. Paused state is retained for 24 hours, but is not durable storage: export finished results. A result with sandbox_created:true indicates a new sandbox, so files from earlier calls are not present; re-download missing inputs. It has internet access: bring files in with curl from media URLs (media_import_url or generation results). For an output created here, call media_upload BEFORE starting the producing command, then append `curl -f -X PUT --upload-file <file> '<upload_url>'` to that SAME command so the ephemeral file is uploaded before it exits; call media_confirm only after HTTP 200. Never pass a sandbox path to media_upload_and_confirm: that tool accepts only client attachments. Commands run in /home/user and time out after timeout_seconds (default 60, max 120); for longer work (large renders, installs) set background:true and poll the returned log/status files with later sandbox_exec calls. Background work receives a 15-minute sandbox lease, and shorter poll calls never reduce its remaining lifetime. Set restart:true to discard the sandbox and start clean. For actual visual inspection, pass image_paths (up to 4 PNG/JPEG paths, <=512 KiB total) with a foreground command: images are returned natively to the model, not as text or URLs. With background work, wait for completion then use a foreground poll with image_paths before its lease expires. No upload is needed for inspection. The command limit is 16000 characters including signed URLs; keep upload batches small and use installed scripts. Workflow bundle scripts are already installed in every sandbox under $HF_WORKFLOWS (/home/user/.higgsfield/workflows), laid out as $HF_WORKFLOWS/<workflow>/scripts/... — run them straight from there (they survive restart:true), and never paste script contents into the command. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

benchmark_relevant_contracts.name: mcp__codex_apps__higgsfield_show_result
benchmark_relevant_contracts.contract: Display a final completed video in its result widget with preview and download. Call after verifying the final export. Include a nonempty action string, optionally include meta as any JSON object, and pass exactly one of media_id (a confirmed owned video UUID) or url (a public HTTPS video URL, up to 50 MB). URL input imports and confirms the video in your media library before displaying it. Prefer media_id for an already uploaded video to avoid duplicate uploads. Never pass a job ID, local path or unfinished render. This tool is part of plugin `Higgsfield`.

No generation, quote, upload, project creation, workspace selection or media-history browsing was invoked.
3D, presenter, ads, website and full-edit workflows exist in the exposed inventory but were not inspected for or used by this benchmark.
upload_caveat: The exposed attachment helper is limited to user-provided ChatGPT attachments; arbitrary repository-derived local files are not automatically eligible. The upload-slot path is specified for files created inside the official remote sandbox. Do not bypass those routing contracts with a local-path assumption or custom API.
